content.title: Masters 2026 prize money: How much did winner Rory McIlroy, other golfers earn?
content.text: Updated April 12, 2026, 9:40 p.m. ETClick here for full recap and results of the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament.Masters Sunday at Augusta National Golf Club has come and gone, and what a day of golf it was.Rory McIlroy became the first back-to-back Masters champion since Tiger Woods over two decades ago after some clutch play in the back nine in the final round Sunday, April 12. It was also the sixth major championship of McIlroy's career.McIlroy was in the driver's seat after the first two days, but an up-and-down third round had him entering Sunday's final round of golf in a tie for first place on the leaderboard with Cameron Young at 11-under par on the tournament. A double bogey (to Jack Nicklaus' dislike) on hole No. 4 and a bogey on hole No. 6 have continued dropped him out of first place for a brief moment, while other golfers like Justin Rose and Scottie Scheffler surged.But McIlroy learned last year how to stare down pressure on the final day of the Masters. The 36-year-old Northern Irishman regathered himself to regain the lead, holding on in the final hole for a one-stroke victory.The congested top of the leaderboard made for some fun golf and meant a shot or putt came in between an "extremely nice" payday and a "nice payday" from the Masters purse, which once again set a new payout record.Here's what to know about the payouts golfers went home with Sunday in the 90th Masters: Masters final leaderboardHere's a look at the top of the leaderboard for the 2026 Masters Tournament:1. Charl Schwartzel (+12) — $51,300How much does Masters winner get?The Masters announced on Saturday that the winner of the 90th edition of the major will take home $4.5 million on Sunday after finishing off the 18th hole — or winning a potential playoff.The $4.5 million winner sharing for the 2026 Masters is an increase of an increase of $300,000 from what McIlroy took home last year as the 2025 Masters champion. He's now won $8.7 million from winning the Masters in the last two years.Masters winner payout, prize money sharingsHere's how much the last five winners of the Masters have earned:2020 winner's share: $1.8 million (Dustin Johnson)2021 winner's share: $2.07 million (Hideki Matsuyama)2022 winner's share: $2.7 million (Scottie Scheffler)2023 winner's share: $3.24 million (Jon Rahm)2024 winner's share: $3.6 million (Scottie Scheffler)2025 winner's share: $4.2 million (Rory McIlroy)2026 winner's share: $4.5 million (Rory McIlroy)The USA TODAY app gets you to the heart of the news — fast.
